request_settings: The maintained Holistic ReAct client sends temperature=0 and does not set reasoning effort. Gateway support must be checked before the batch.
task_input: Unitree H1's complete maintained public task library (20 entries). The downstream shortlist selects representative supported operation families without changing the generation input.
scope: One initial Unitree H1 generation through the existing Study, Design, Generate, Validate and Export pipeline. The wider six-robot thesis generation count is unchanged. Downstream ReCAP uses run_tasks.py with this configuration.
budget_note: This run uses the same generation iteration limits as the earlier cases. Generation uses the prepared Opus 5 model. Downstream ReCAP uses Astra with the prepared increased budgets.

tasks.name: Select and touch a target button

downstream_plan.preparation_scope: Five H1 task families, each attempted once in the central condition. The source catalog's criteria, scene dimensions and 30-second deadline are retained. All added fixtures use only existing H1 collision geometry and the native MuJoCo model; no hand or unavailable actuator is introduced.
